About this item

【ADVANTAGES】Features a powerful 1500W peak power motor, large frame, and 20" fat tires. Includes a color display, front fork and seat shock absorber, front & rear disc brakes, 7-speed shifting system, front basket, rear rack, removable battery, and step-thru design.
【1500W PEAK POWER MOTOR】Equipped with a 1000W motor (peak 1500W), this e-bike can reach speeds of up to 28+++ mph and has a torque of 70-90 Nm. It easily conquers 25-35° slopes, providing superior hill-climbing ability and faster speeds compared to a 750W motor.
【UL 2849 CERTIFIED LITHIUM BATTERY】The e-bike features a 48V 15AH battery that provides a pure electric range of up to 30 miles and a pedal assist range of up to 50 miles. The battery is UL 2849 certified, ensuring safety and power-saving. It can be removed and charged anywhere, with a fast charging time of 4-6 hours.
【20" FAT TIRES & DUAL SHOCK ABSORBERS】With 20"x4.0" fat tires, this e-bike delivers a smooth and comfortable ride on various rugged terrains. The front fork and seat dual shock absorbers reduce road bumps by 85%, enhancing your overall riding experience.
【DUAL DISC BRAKES】The dual disc brake system ensures stable and reliable braking performance, even at high speeds. This gives you the confidence to ride boldly and safely in different riding conditions.
【COLOR LCD DISPLAY】The upgraded color LCD display offers an enhanced viewing experience, especially in sunlight. It provides real-time information on your e-bike's speed, battery level, distance covered, and pedal-assist level. The display is concise and easy to read, keeping you well-informed during your rides.
【OTHER RELIABLE DESIGNS】The step-thru frame design allows for easy mounting and dismounting of the e-bike. It also features a front basket and rear rack for convenient storage of your belongings. The front & rear fenders keep you clean from dirt, while the front headlight and tail light ensure your safety during night rides.

Product Description

Unleash your adventures with our foldable fat tire electric bike for women.

Designed for year-round exploration, it effortlessly conquers city streets, sandy beaches, and snowy terrains.
Its compact foldable design ensures easy storage and portability.
With a powerful electric motor and sturdy fat tires, enjoy a smooth and thrilling ride on any surface. Elevate your outdoor experiences with style and convenience.
Get yours now and embark on unforgettable journeys.

Powerful Motor
Equipped with a 1000W (PEAK 1500W)brushless motor and a top speed of 28+++ Mph, our e-bike conquers all terrains effortlessly. The robust controller ensures optimal motor performance and longevity.

Removable Battery
With a 48V 15Ah battery, our e-bike offers a range of 35 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal-assist mode.
The removable design makes it convenient to take out and install the battery.

Super Bright Headlight and Brake Light
Our electric bike features waterproof headlights and brake lights, ensuring safe night riding. Ride with confidence and clarity, whether you're commuting after work or exploring new trails in the dark.

Colorful LCD display
The Colorful LCD digital display provides clear visibility of speed, mileage, battery level, PAS, and other essential information.

Double Shock Absorption
The adjustable front forks and seat shock absorption provide improved damping, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride. Say goodbye to bumps on rough roads with our enhanced suspension system.

Twist Grip Throttle & Shamano 7-Speed
Twisting the throttle releases your thumb for effortless speed control and enhanced safety. The Shamano 7-Speed system provides a wide shifting range, enabling smooth and precise gear changes on various surfaces.

Equipped with a dependable dual mechanical disc brake system, ensuring effective braking performance in a short amount of time. Enjoy the thrill of high-speed riding with enhanced safety.

Foldable Design
The MN20 ebike offers a simple folding mechanism, allowing easy storage in your bike's trunk. Maximize space and enhance your RV, camper, or van adventures with this compact and convenient solution.
